hero.bio: Engineer. I like <accent>efficient solutions to hard problems</accent>, and interfaces that feel good to use.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A few things I built because the problem was interesting.

items.open-portfolio: Elixir MCP server and LiveView dashboard over a real brokerage portfolio.
items.crimp-studio: Climbing wall route setter with draggable 3D holds and undo/redo history.
items.mandibible: Jaw anatomy rendered as graphite hatching, from real CBCT scans.
items.claude-checkpoint-diagram: Claude Code plugin that renders Mermaid checkpoints at agent pauses.
items.hiit-maker: Interval training builder, rebuilt on Vite and React 19 as an offline PWA.
